title: Fix nested tokio runtime panic in MQTT soft mutex spec
description: The Rust cucumber scenario features/coordination/mqtt_soft_mutex.feature 'Contention window closes into LEASE for the deterministic winner' fails deterministically on develop with 'Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime'. Reproduce: cd rust && KANBUS_CUCUMBER_FEATURE_FILTER='mqtt soft mutex' cargo test --test cucumber. The panic comes from rust/features/steps/coordination_steps.rs calling rust/src/gossip.rs collect_coordination_gossip_window_with, which blocks on a runtime inside the cucumber async executor. Develop CI reports green, so also check whether CI runs this feature or whether the failure depends on local state such as a live broker on 127.0.0.1:1883. Fix without nesting runtimes (for example spawn_blocking or a dedicated thread).
